releaseNotes:
Notes v1.8.28 (Build 200):
• Calculator Decoy: Adjustable '=' button long-press unlock duration (1s–5s) in Profile Settings
• Streamlined Decoy Unlock: Exclusively number passcode and '=' long-press unlock; other secret gestures removed
• Decoy Keyboard Suppression: Software keyboard completely suppressed on calculator screen
• Samsung One UI Day/Night Theme: Authentic bottom alignment and official color system
• Voice & Audio: Smooth voice chat timing and improved chat scroll performance
